description:
The signed-in user's bookings from the last three months on, latest start first, at most 100. Each carries
bookingId for get_booking and cancel_booking, and geoHash with placeId for booking that place again.
name: list_my_bookings

bookings.description: The caller's bookings that start within the last three months or later, latest start first.

capacityReserved.description: Capacity held, e.g. the party size.

geoHash.description: GeoHash of the place; with placeId it is what the booking tools take. Absent on old rows.

paymentStatus.description: Payment state recorded by the business.

status.description: PENDING, CONFIRMED, COMPLETED, DECLINED, CANCELLED_BY_CUSTOMER, CANCELLED_BY_STAFF or NO_SHOW.

title: My bookings
